reply_text:
I replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the site was the Southgate depot.

That comes from Priyanka's posts in that channel on 2025-09-03. She said label printing had stalled across Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. At 18:43 she posted that Southgate had cleared the backlog and closed the incident.

No one in the channel gave a fuller address for the depot, and I found no shared files for Tansley, so I told him I couldn't add more. Tobias is a member of the channel, so everything I quoted is something he can already see.
